记录自动保存在这台电脑。: History is saved on this computer.
AI 分析时，评论会发送给所配置的模型服务。: AI analysis sends review text to the configured model service.
实验数据与网页历史分开保存。: Evaluation data is separate from workspace history.
把用户反馈变成可行动的问题: Turn app reviews into product insights
分类、严重程度、用户需求与原文依据，一起查看。: Inspect issue categories, severity, user needs and source evidence.
AI 会调用一次模型，同时保留关键词分类，方便并排比较。分析成功后自动保存。: AI makes one model call per review and retains the keyword baseline for comparison. Results are saved automatically.
必须包含 review 列，可增加 review_id 列。最多 500 条，每: Include a review column; review_id is optional. Maximum 500 rows, 2000 characters per review and 2 MB per file.
上传只预览，不调用 AI。确认开始后，每条调用一次；顺序处理，完成一条保存一条。: Upload previews the file without AI calls. After confirmation, reviews run sequentially and each result is saved. Pause waits for the current request to finish.
先打开分析历史，在批次下方填写应用名称和评论所属周。周报使用保存的结果，不调用模: Open a saved batch and assign an app name and review week. Reports reuse saved results without model calls. Weeks run Monday to Sunday; analysis time does not determine the review week.
尚未生成周报。已有历史可以补填所属周；首次使用没有上周数据也能生成本周摘要。: No report generated yet. Assign review weeks to saved batches. A current-week summary is available even without previous-week data.
选择该周任意一天，会归到周一。一个批次应只含同一应用、同一周的评论；混合文件请先: Choose any day in the review week; it is stored as Monday. Each batch must contain one app and one week. Split mixed files first. Use a separate app name such as DEMO for synthetic examples.
点击任意行查看原文、关键词结果、完整 AI 结果及依据。统计面板不随列表筛选改变: Select a row to inspect its source text, keyword baseline, AI fields and evidence. Charts describe the whole batch and do not change with list filters.
固定关键词基线，只判断大类；无法判断严重程度或提取需求。: The keyword baseline predicts broad categories only; it does not estimate severity or extract needs.
从一条评论开始，或导入 CSV。: Start with one review or import a CSV.
完成后，在这里查看结果、汇总和原文依据。: Inspect results, distributions and source evidence here.
V5 分析流程 · 四个问题大类 / 十个固定主题。结果用于辅助反馈整理，需结合: V5 analysis: four categories and ten fixed topics. Use results to assist triage and check them against source reviews.
个人本地版本；评估分数属于已保存的小规模实验，不代表当前输入的真实准确率。: Personal local prototype. Recorded small-sample evaluation scores do not establish accuracy on your input.
请输入运行此应用的人提供的局域网访问码：: Enter the LAN access code supplied by the person running this app:
本地服务无法响应，请确认启动窗口仍然打开。: The local service is unavailable. Keep the launcher terminal open.
请双击启动入口，打开完整本地版本。: Open the launcher to use the full local workspace.
将分析 ${imported.length} 条评论，每条调用一次模型并使用 A: Analyse ${imported.length} reviews with one paid model call per review. Continue?
已读入 ${preview.count} 条有效评论。尚未调用 AI。: Loaded ${preview.count} valid reviews. No AI calls have been made.
${preview.errors.length} 行未导入。以下行不会参与分析：: ${preview.errors.length} rows were skipped and will not be analysed:
CSV 文件超过 2 MB，请拆分。: The CSV exceeds 2 MB. Split the file.
请使用 UTF-8 编码的 CSV 文件。: Use a UTF-8 encoded CSV file.
分布仅统计 ${success.length} 条有效 AI 结果；失败项不归入: Distributions use ${success.length} accepted AI results and exclude failures. ${different} differ from the keyword baseline; disagreement does not prove error. Tokens include recorded retries; consult the provider for unknown billed usage.
关键词模式只提供大类；没有严重程度、需求、主题或证据，也不调用模型。: Keyword mode provides categories only, without severity, needs, topics or evidence, and makes no model calls.
已通过字段及逐字引用检查；是否正确理解评论仍需要人工判断。: Fields and exact quotation passed validation. Correct interpretation still requires human review.
本次只运行关键词规则，未调用 AI。: This batch used keyword rules only, without AI calls.
模型正在分析这条评论…: The model is analysing this review...
将重新调用失败、无效或中断项。中断请求可能已经计费，重试会增加 API 用量。待: Retry failed, invalid or interrupted reviews? Interrupted requests may already be billed. Retries add API usage and pending reviews will also continue.
批次归属已更新，请重新生成周报。: Batch assignment updated. Generate the report again.
已保存周报归属，不会重新分析评论。: Report assignment saved without reanalysing reviews.
请先为批次保存应用名称和评论所属周。: Assign an app name and review week to a saved batch first.
本周 ${current.batches.length} 个批次，去重后 ${c: Current week: ${current.batches.length} batches, ${current.rows.length} unique reviews, ${current.valid.length} accepted; ${current.rows.length-current.valid.length} excluded from distributions. Removed ${current.duplicates} duplicates.
上周 ${prior.batches.length} 个批次，去重后 ${pri: Previous week: ${prior.batches.length} batches, ${prior.rows.length} unique reviews, ${prior.valid.length} accepted; ${prior.rows.length-prior.valid.length} excluded from distributions. Removed ${prior.duplicates} duplicates.
本周没有有效结果，无法生成主题分布。先检查所属周、分析方式或失败状态。: No accepted current-week results. Check review weeks, analysis method and failed statuses.
上周没有有效结果：仅显示本周摘要，不计算增长率或占比变化。: No accepted previous-week results: showing the current-week summary without growth or share changes.
包含不同模型或提示词版本，分类变化可能来自分析方式变化，趋势需谨慎核对。: Different models or prompt versions are present. Method changes may affect classification; interpret trends cautiously.
占比分母为各周有效去重结果。重复评论按文本忽略大小写和多余空白合并；不同用户的相: Shares use accepted unique reviews in each week. Deduplication ignores case and extra whitespace; identical text from different users may also be merged. This compares selected batches, not all users or real-world incidence.
本周模型标记为高严重程度：${current.valid.filter(x=>x: Current week: ${current.valid.filter(x=>x.row.result.severity==='high').length} reviews marked high severity by the model. Check source text; these are not confirmed losses or urgent incidents.
重点主题按本周数量排序，示例优先展示模型标记为高严重程度的评论。主题归组不等于同: Topics are ranked by current-week count; examples marked high severity appear first. A topic group is not proof of one shared fault or an automatic product priority.
设置已改变，请重新生成周报。: Settings changed. Generate the report again.
这是文件预览，只能运行单条关键词分类，不会保存。请双击「启动反馈分析.comma: This file preview supports single-review keyword classification without saving. Open Launch_Feedback_Studio_EN.command for the full app.
AI 密钥未配置。关键词功能可用；请关闭服务并双击启动入口，在终端输入密钥。: No API key configured. Keyword features remain available. Stop the service and reopen the launcher to enter your key.
本地服务已连接 · 密钥已配置: Local service connected · API key configured
本地服务已连接 · 未配置密钥: Local service connected · No API key configured
查看原始响应与请求记录: View raw responses and request records
查看原评论与完整结果: View source review and full result
CSV 文件不能超过 2 MB。: The CSV must not exceed 2 MB.
CSV 第一行必须有 review 列；可另有 review_id 列。: The CSV header must contain review; review_id is optional.
CSV 列名不能重复。: CSV column names must be unique.
每个 CSV 最多 500 条数据，请拆分文件。: Each CSV supports up to 500 reviews. Split larger files.
没有可分析的评论。: There are no reviews to analyse.
服务中断，无法确定请求是否已完成或计费；不会自动重发。: The service was interrupted. Completion and billing are unknown; the request will not be resent automatically.
分析方式必须为 ai 或 rule。: Analysis method must be ai or rule.
尚未配置 API 密钥。请通过启动入口设置后重新打开。: No API key is configured. Set it through the launcher and reopen the app.
已有 AI 分析运行中，请先等待或暂停它。: An AI batch is running. Wait for it or pause it first.
请填写应用名称（1–100字符）。: Enter an app name of 1 to 100 characters.
请选择评论所属周的日期。: Select a date in the review week.
已有 AI 分析运行中，请等待当前请求完成。: An AI batch is running. Wait for the current request to finish.
这次历史分析使用了不同提示词或模型；请新建分析，避免混合结果。: This saved batch used a different model or prompt. Create a new analysis to avoid mixing results.
尚未配置 API 密钥，请重新通过启动入口设置。: No API key is configured. Reopen the launcher to set it.
没有待处理项。失败项需单独点击重试。: No pending reviews remain. Use retry for failed reviews.
关键词分析已完成，无需暂停或继续。: Keyword analysis is complete; pause and resume do not apply.
请先等待当前请求完成。: Wait for the current request to finish.
密钥未配置或模型/提示词已变更；请配置密钥或新建分析。: The key is missing or the model/prompt changed. Configure the key or create a new analysis.
模型字段不符合要求，或引用未逐字匹配原评论。原始响应已保存。: The output fields are invalid or the quote does not exactly match the review. The raw response was saved.
API 请求失败，已暂停。请检查网络、密钥或余额；失败请求是否计费以服务商记录为: The API request failed and the batch is paused. Check the network, key or balance. Consult the provider for billing of failed requests.
处理意外中断，不会自动重发；请检查存储空间并手动确认是否重试。: Processing was interrupted and will not restart automatically. Check storage and decide whether to retry.
请通过本机地址打开网页。: Open the app using its localhost address.
请刷新网页后重试。: Refresh the page and try again.
请求为空或过大，CSV 最多 2 MB。: The request is empty or too large. CSV files are limited to 2 MB.
CSV 格式无法读取，请检查引号、分隔符和编码。: Cannot read the CSV. Check quotes, separators and encoding.
无法保存本地记录，请检查磁盘空间和文件权限。: Cannot save local history. Check disk space and file permissions.
